authenticated_probes: FMP bounded matrix recorded exact-session, DST, winter, summer and early-close observations.

conservative_assumptions: UW created_at is an operational availability proxy with a 60-second cutoff, not publication time.
The owner explicitly approved RV30, the FMP +1 minute assumption, the UW operational proxy and the bounded daily audit; these approvals do not turn assumptions into provider publication evidence.
provider_documentation: FMP exposes one-minute OHLCV, states a point appears after the candle closes and timestamps use exchange local time, but does not label the date as start or close.
UW documents OptionTrade created_at as the time the trade record was created and Full Tape executed_at as execution time; publication and historical availability semantics are not defined.
interpretation_guardrails: created_at, bid/ask side, sweep, call/put and premium are descriptive fields only; they are not interpreted as trader intention, informed trading or directional sentiment.
